scope: Official zcode-guide plugin content version 0.3.0: 6 skill documents under skills/ (five diagnosing-* guides plus the configuration guide), README.md and .zcode-plugin/plugin.json. Verbatim copy, no local modifications. commands/workflow.md and skills/dynamic-workflows/* are no longer part of this plugin in 0.3.0 upstream either; /workflow is now a built-in command and dynamic-workflows ships in apps/zcode-cli/packages/bundled-skills (registered separately). The upstream package.json is intentionally not redistributed: apps/zcode-cli/packages/* is a pnpm workspace glob, so a copied manifest would register this directory as a workspace importer and break `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; the MIT declaration is retained in the copied .zcode-plugin/plugin.json.

provenance: Copied from the official open-source checkout zai-org/ZCode at revision 29628c9 (feat: update v3.14.3), which is the commit that introduced the Bot Channel block. The upstream repository declares license Apache-2.0 in package.json; the LICENSE snapshot pinned here is that repository's Apache-2.0 text (sha256 verified byte-for-byte). 21 of the 27 copied files are byte-identical to upstream; the remaining 6 are listed in modifiedFiles. Upstream records no per-file copyright header, so no upstream-supplied notice line exists to reproduce. Formatting note: the copied sources were additionally run through this repository's oxfmt (0.41.0) because pnpm fmt:check covers packages/services. Upstream does NOT keep this block oxfmt-clean (measured: 18 of 27 upstream files fail our oxfmt), so 19 files are no longer byte-identical to upstream for formatting reasons alone. That formatting-only set was verified by formatting a pristine upstream copy with the same formatter and comparing byte-for-byte: 23 files match the formatted upstream exactly, and only the 4 files in locallyModifiedFiles carry substantive local edits. All copied files were copied verbatim first; no semantic change was introduced by formatting.
scope: Bot Channel (IM bot) subsystem: packages/services/src/bots/** (27 files, 13830 lines at upstream) plus packages/shared/src/bots.ts (558 lines) — the shared schema/type contract for that subsystem. The Apache-2.0 basis covers these copied sources. The Feishu channel lazily imports @larksuiteoapi/node-sdk, which is a separately registered npm dependency (MIT), not part of this copy. Two files in this directory (attachmentPathGuard.ts, attachmentUrlGuard.ts) are ZCode-CE originals added for SSRF and path-traversal hardening, not upstream copies.
